messages.text: Hello, can you see my messages?
I'm watching your every stream, and you mentioned me 0 times in recent streams, thanks for appreciation I guess

Hello, why you don't mention me on your every stream??? I told you I will be listening your streams but in recording!
Do you know its not me who is talking to you right now?
I wrote a bot to send those messages. I am literally sleeping right now! I will listen to your replies tomorrow
